observations: Live MuJoCo floating-base simulation at 500 Hz; CAD-derived loaded mass displayed as 6.902 kg.
Final current model trot run reached 105.53 s; 2 loaded feet, 223 mm body height, 6.21 Nm peak torque; paused for handoff.
Pause freezes physics time; changing a motion or physical profile requires rebuilding before resume.
35 N lateral push changes real force and IMU readings; motor cutoff removes actuation while gravity continues.
12 actual joint angles, speeds, torques and soft joint limits are displayed; soft-limit overtravel is visibly flagged.
ROS ZIP, URDF, MJCF, inertia JSON, run JSON and telemetry CSV controls are present; ZIP and report HTTP responses were separately verified by API tests.
Mobile 390 x 844 view has no horizontal overflow and keeps the robot below the compact force HUD.
CAD foot pad design dimensions and generated recipe agree at 26 x 24 x 32 mm.
Standalone HTML retains CAD and kinematics; physics start is disabled with a Python/MuJoCo server explanation.
Tour switches from physical simulation to the kinematic presentation; Escape returns to Studio.
Final live WebGL2 view ran approximately 49 to 54 fps; no new warning/error console entries since final audit start.
limitations: WebGPU live physics and mobile views worked earlier, but one late IAB WebGPU reload stalled during renderer initialization; the handoff explicitly selects WebGL2.
Browser download buttons were exercised and backend files verified, but the IAB saved-download path was not independently confirmed.
ROS 2 launch, RViz and physical hardware were not available and have not been validated.
Motor capacity, friction and several mass allocations remain engineering assumptions; contact uses convex meshes and there is no whole-body balance controller.
Existing historical console warnings from earlier trail-buffer code were excluded by timestamp; the final buffer implementation produced no fresh warnings.
